resources.string: Draft settings: use the public ShadowTLS listener as the inner profile’s server and port. The handshake name and password are independent of inner credentials. Inner encryption and server verification remain required. ShadowTLS carries no native UDP; compatible inner protocols retain UDP over streams. Saving settings does not verify Android connection support.
These settings require protected Raw configuration. Existing values are retained.
Enter a valid ShadowTLS handshake name and a nonempty password.
